item.title: FramePair 0.3.6
item.description:
# FramePair 0.3.6
- Photo cards and grids now use consistent layouts, making filenames, pixel dimensions, aspect ratios, and selection easier to scan. Duplicated entries display the original filename. - Warnings and information popovers share a consistent layout. Where hover previews are available, you can take a quick look, then click or use the keyboard to keep the details open. - Fixed the three-photo Merge preview when card height is limited. An outline highlights the slot selected for filling. - Moved the aspect ratio warning and reset button next to the filename in the Split editor. Fixed an issue where cropped previews covered the drag handle used to reorder the two Split results together. - Export progress and cancellation now appear in the bottom bar. Estimate and export errors show the cause and let you copy the relevant file paths.

# FramePair 0.3.6
- 统一照片卡片与网格的布局，让文件名、像素尺寸、画面比例和选中状态更容易辨认。复制后的照片条目显示原始文件名 - 统一警告与信息详情的样式。支持悬停的详情可快速预览，点击或用键盘打开后会保持展开，方便阅读 - 修复三图拼合预览在卡片高度受限时的布局问题，并用边框清楚标出当前要填入的槽位 - 将拆分编辑器的比例提醒和重置按钮移到文件名旁，并修复裁切后的预览遮挡排序手柄的问题。左右两张结果可在输出预览中一起拖动排序 - 将实时导出进度和取消入口集中到底栏。估算或导出出现问题时，会显示原因及可复制的相关文件路径

item.title: FramePair 0.3.5
item.description:
# FramePair 0.3.5
- Combine two or three photos with the same exact aspect ratio at different pixel sizes by enabling Allow Different Sizes in Merge in General Settings; larger photos are reduced to the smallest size in the group while preserving the full frame - Review Downscaled labels in Merge Photos to see each affected photo’s dimensions before and after resizing - Apply the setting to the current batch immediately; turning it off asks before ungrouping incompatible merges and keeps same-size merges intact

# FramePair 0.3.5
- 在 General Settings 开启「允许 Merge 使用不同尺寸」后，可将精确同比例、不同像素尺寸的两张或三张照片拼合；较大照片按组内最小尺寸缩小，保留完整画面 - 在 Merge Photos 通过「已缩小」Label 查看受影响照片及其缩小前后尺寸 - 设置立即作用于当前批次；关闭时先确认是否解散不兼容组，同尺寸组保持不变

item.title: FramePair 0.3.4
item.description:
# FramePair 0.3.4
- Start from a compact import window with recent folders and an optional portrait or landscape output ratio; review ratio mismatches before export without blocking it - Adjust Split framing in its own step: enable a continuous crop whose two halves match the target ratio, with movement, resizing, reset, keyboard control, and Undo / Redo - Reuse a source photo through independent workspace copies, including in the same Merge, and choose a default processing mode for new entries - Keep photo grids, window layouts, and previews readable at different window sizes; the four processing choices remain stable during rapid scrolling - Recover from import and output-estimate failures, and edit a completed batch to export again with the existing file-safety checks - Use File-menu import and export commands, and reorder output groups or operate Merge slots with VoiceOver - Use a refreshed app icon with light and dark appearances

# FramePair 0.3.4
- 从紧凑启动页访问最近文件夹，并按需选择横向或竖向目标输出比例；导出前可查看比例差异，提示不会阻止导出 - 在独立 Split 步骤中调整取景：主动开启连续裁剪，使左右两格各自符合目标比例，支持移动、缩放、重置、键盘操作及 Undo / Redo - 通过独立工作区副本复用同一照片，也可将同源条目加入同一个 Merge；新增条目的默认处理方式可在 Settings 配置 - 改善不同窗口尺寸下的照片网格、布局和预览，快速滚动时四项处理方式保持稳定 - 导入或输出估算失败后可直接恢复；已完成批次可继续编辑并重新导出，沿用现有文件安全检查 - 通过 File 菜单导入与导出，使用 VoiceOver 调整输出组顺序和操作 Merge 槽位 - 更新应用图标，支持明暗外观

item.title: FramePair 0.3.1
item.description:
# FramePair 0.3.1
- Correct photos that are slightly above or below a built-in or custom aspect ratio by cropping excess pixels or repeating edge pixels to fill a small shortfall; previews and JPEG / PNG exports use the same corrected dimensions - Auto Crop is now named Auto Ratio Correction, with details showing the cropped or added pixels on each affected edge - Remove a source photo using the button at the top-right of its preview; the arrangement picker has its own row

# FramePair 0.3.1
- 接近内置或自定义比例的照片，无论像素略多还是略少，都可通过裁切或边缘像素复制补齐为精确比例；预览与 JPEG / PNG 输出使用一致的校正尺寸 - Auto Crop 更名为「自动比例校正」，详情分别显示各边实际裁切或补齐的像素 - 来源照片的移除按钮固定在预览右上角，处理方式选择器独占一行

item.title: FramePair 0.3
item.description:
FramePair 0.3 focuses on flexible photo arrangements and export preparation:
- Mix multiple arrangements in one batch: Direct keeps one photo as one output; Merge 2 and Merge 3 stack two or three photos vertically; Split divides one wide photo at its visual center into left and right outputs - View candidate photos and merge results together in Merge Photos, replace an individual photo, fill an empty position, and exchange the top and bottom photos - Track pixel dimensions and aspect ratios across source photos, arrangements, and Output Preview - Optionally use Auto Crop to remove a few edge pixels when a photo is only slightly outside a common ratio - Reorder finished arrangements in Output Preview and export them with automatic sequential numbering - Apply a per-file JPEG size limit and review the estimated size and encoding quality before export - Mix JPEG, PNG, and single-image TIFF sources in one batch, then export the batch as JPEG or lossless PNG - Use the interface in English or Simplified Chinese and check for updates from within the application

FramePair 0.3 重点完善多张照片的灵活编排与导出准备：
- 同一批次可混合使用多种处理方式：Direct 保持单张输出；Merge 2 与 Merge 3 分别将两张或三张照片上下拼合；Split 将一张宽图从视觉中心分成左右两张 - Merge Photos 同时显示候选照片与拼合结果，可替换单张照片、回填空缺并交换顶部和底部位置 - 来源照片、编排过程和 Output Preview 持续显示像素尺寸与画面比例 - 可选的 Auto Crop 会移除边缘的少量像素，修正与常见比例只有轻微偏差的照片 - Output Preview 支持拖动调整成片顺序，导出时按照确认后的顺序自动连续编号 - JPEG 输出可设置逐文件大小上限，并在导出前显示预计文件大小和编码质量 - 同一批次可混合导入 JPEG、PNG 与单图 TIFF，并统一导出为 JPEG 或无损 PNG - 界面支持英文与简体中文，并新增应用内更新检查
